summary: Layer 2B maps the candidate chunk into ticker-to-node relationships across semiconductor equipment, test/probe, optical connectivity, silicon photonics, and high-speed interconnect. The strongest relationship evidence in this call remains thematic and node-level rather than ticker-specific: AI servers are pulling on advanced substrates, passives, power delivery, data-center electrical equipment, optical connectivity, and potentially semiconductor test intensity. Within the chunk, underfollowed candidates with plausible chokepoint relationships include COHU and FORM in test/probe, TSEM in silicon-photonics specialty foundry capacity, LITE/MTSI/SMTC in optical and signal-integrity components, and CRDO in active electrical connectivity. Reference names such as Canon, Disco, Fabrinet, and Coherent help anchor the map but should not crowd out the small/mid-cap verification lane. No buy/sell recommendation or price target is implied.
